summary: Materialized and read full AQUINAS-ST-I-Q104-A1-EN and newly pinned complete author articles SCHMID-INERTIA-REPLY-3-ARTICLE (7 July 2021) and FESER-INERTIA-REPLY-2021-ARTICLE (6 July 2021), excluding reader comments. Exact paragraph locators, strongest responses and typed-interface inventory persist in docs/eternity-dependence-connection.md, Existential inertia section. Schmid accepts a PSR-like principle and proposes earlier existence plus absence of destructive causal change as extrinsic explanation without concurrent efficient sustenance; rejected treating this rival as merely brute persistence. Feser contests past-state sufficiency and alleges substance/persistence-power circularity; he expressly rejects annihilation/recreation conservation. Q104 objections and replies distinguish incorruptibility, completed production, preventing corruption and continuation of esse-giving without motion/time. Rejected identifying explanations with efficient causes, times with worlds, per-time causes with one fixed cause, or conditional typed correspondence with existence of a conserver. Existing direct essence-esse theorem yields double-negated identity only under its listed actual-target, no-support and interface/causal hypotheses; it does not defend conservation. No new shared vocabulary, Lean result, philosophical claim or root discharge is manufactured. Source assertions and this successful reading attempt do not establish target propositions.
blocker: Independently defend concurrent esse-dependence against the prior-existence/no-destruction replacement; separately defend conservation-to-CausesIn interpretation and actual support interfaces for the same bearer.
